name: MultiFreq

args.name: submodel
args.description: Constructs a branch model from its frequency vector

args.name: freqs
args.description: The weighted distribution of frequency vectors available to nodes

args.name: nodeFreqs
args.description: The frequency vector assigned to each node

description: Allows composition to vary among branches of a rooted tree. Each node selects a frequency vector from a weighted collection of n vectors. A branch uses the vector assigned to its child node to construct its substitution model; the root assignment determines the starting frequencies. These branch-specific equilibrium frequencies need not equal the actual frequencies reached along the tree.
